race.description: Tg More From Tote With Ladbrokes 8-15
race.comment: COMING THROUGH (1) was in the minors two back (17.56) at this track but ran below best last time there, finishing 6th. Form here at the trip sound including two wins. Has claims if he runs up to expectations. ARCADIA PRIZE (7) was a strong course and distance winner last time, claiming a Maiden in a powerful 17.79 and a new PB here. Expected to feature again. TRALEE RHONDA (3) is worth consideration after filling a hole last start.
